item.description:
### Fixed - **Perch no longer freezes when a command it runs hangs.** Your own Claude status line (when Perch wraps it), `tailscale status` and Keychain reads for usage now give up after a few seconds instead of waiting forever. - **A Keychain that won't open no longer reads as "signed out".** Perch keeps your usage bars and any "sign-in expired" warning instead of clearing them. - **Uninstalling Perch's hooks leaves other tools' settings alone.** Removing Perch from Codex, Cursor, Devin, Droid or Muse now takes out only Perch's own entries, backs the file up first, and checks the result, putting the file back if anything went wrong.
### Security - **Perch's own data files are private to your account.** The status-line, cost and spend files Perch keeps could be created readable by other accounts on the Mac. They're now written private, and existing ones are tightened when Perch starts. - Perch double-checks its own data folder before tidying it at launch, so it never deletes or changes files somewhere else.
